scope: Current-state review; no mutations, no historical repair, no API mutation tests

checks.name: database
checks.sql: SELECT DATABASE() AS databaseName, DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ') AS observedUtc

checks.name: balanceMissingReferences
checks.sql: SELECT SUM(l.id IS NULL) AS missingLotReferences,SUM(i.id IS NULL) AS missingInventoryReferences,COUNT(*) AS affectedBalanceRows FROM inventory_lot_balances b LEFT JOIN inventory_lots l ON l.id=b.lotId LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.id=b.inventoryId WHERE l.id IS NULL OR i.id IS NULL

checks.name: stockLotDifferences
checks.sql: SELECT i.id,i.internalCode,i.itemName,i.warehouseId,i.quantity AS stockQuantity,b.lotQuantity,i.quantity-b.lotQuantity AS difference,i.updatedAt FROM inventory i JOIN (SELECT inventoryId,SUM(quantity) AS lotQuantity FROM inventory_lot_balances GROUP BY inventoryId) b ON b.inventoryId=i.id WHERE i.isFrozen=0 AND ABS(i.quantity-b.lotQuantity)>0.0005 ORDER BY i.id

rows.itemName: قلم ناشف ازرق PRIMA موديل PR-40775 نوع X3  - م 0.7 مم
قلم ناشف ازرق PRIMA موديل PR-40775 نوع X3  - م 0.7 مم

checks.name: lotDistributionDifferences
checks.sql: SELECT l.id,l.lotCode,l.remainingQuantity,COALESCE(b.quantity,0) AS locatedQuantity,l.createdAt,l.updatedAt FROM inventory_lots l LEFT JOIN (SELECT lotId,SUM(quantity) AS quantity FROM inventory_lot_balances GROUP BY lotId) b ON b.lotId=l.id WHERE ABS(l.remainingQuantity-COALESCE(b.quantity,0))>0.0005 ORDER BY l.id

checks.name: trackedValueDifferences
checks.sql: SELECT i.id,i.internalCode,i.quantity,i.averageCost,i.totalCostValue,ROUND(i.quantity*i.averageCost,2) AS expectedValue FROM inventory i WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_lot_balances b WHERE b.inventoryId=i.id) AND ABS(i.totalCostValue-ROUND(i.quantity*i.averageCost,2))>GREATEST(0.01,CEIL(ABS(i.quantity)*0.00005*100)/100)+0.000001

checks.name: closedTicketOpenItem
checks.sql: SELECT t.id,t.ticketNumber,t.status AS headerStatus,i.status AS itemStatus,t.closedAt,t.updatedAt AS headerUpdatedAt,i.updatedAt AS itemUpdatedAt FROM tickets t JOIN (SELECT ticketId,MIN(id) AS itemId FROM ticket_items GROUP BY ticketId HAVING COUNT(*)=1) x ON x.ticketId=t.id JOIN ticket_items i ON i.id=x.itemId WHERE COALESCE(t.workflowModel,'legacy')<>'department_tasks' AND t.status IN ('closed','requester_confirmed') AND i.status NOT IN ('closed','requester_confirmed') ORDER BY t.id

checks.name: receivedValue
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS receivedItems,SUM(actualTotalCost) AS actualRecordedOnly,SUM(COALESCE(actualTotalCost,estimatedTotalCost,0)) AS includingEstimate,SUM(actualTotalCost IS NULL) AS missingActualCost,SUM(actualTotalCost=0) AS zeroActualCost FROM purchase_order_items WHERE status IN ('delivered_to_warehouse','delivered_to_requester')

checks.name: missingActualReceivedItems
checks.sql: SELECT p.poNumber,i.id,i.itemName,i.status,i.actualTotalCost,i.estimatedTotalCost,i.receivedAt,i.deliveredAt FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id=i.purchaseOrderId WHERE i.status IN ('delivered_to_warehouse','delivered_to_requester') AND i.actualTotalCost IS NULL

checks.name: orphanReceiptLines
checks.sql: SELECT i.id,i.receiptId,i.inventoryId,i.receivedQuantity,i.createdAt FROM warehouse_receipt_items i LEFT JOIN warehouse_receipts r ON r.id=i.receiptId WHERE r.id IS NULL

checks.name: missingDeliveryMovement
checks.sql: SELECT d.id,d.deliveryNumber,d.inventoryTransactionId,d.inventoryId,d.lotId,d.quantity,d.createdAt FROM delivery_documents d LEFT JOIN inventory_transactions m ON m.id=d.inventoryTransactionId WHERE d.inventoryTransactionId IS NOT NULL AND m.id IS NULL

checks.name: archivedMovementCheck
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS archivedMatches FROM inventory_transactions_legacy_orphans WHERE id=450834

checks.name: duplicateDeliveryNumbers
checks.sql: SELECT d.id,d.deliveryNumber,d.inventoryTransactionId,d.inventoryId,d.lotId,d.quantity,d.createdAt FROM delivery_documents d JOIN (SELECT deliveryNumber FROM delivery_documents GROUP BY deliveryNumber HAVING COUNT(*)>1) x ON x.deliveryNumber=d.deliveryNumber ORDER BY d.deliveryNumber,d.id

checks.name: closedParentExample
checks.sql: SELECT p.id,p.ticketNumber,p.status,COUNT(c.id) AS children,SUM(c.status NOT IN ('closed','requester_confirmed')) AS openChildren FROM tickets p JOIN tickets c ON c.parentTicketId=p.id WHERE p.ticketNumber IN ('MT-2026-00579','MT-2026-00578') GROUP BY p.id,p.ticketNumber,p.status

checks.name: openExecutionWatchlist
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS openExecutions,SUM(priority='critical') AS criticalExecutions,SUM(createdAt<UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 48 HOUR) AS olderThan48Hours,SUM(maintenanceResponsibleManagerId IS NULL) AS noPrimaryManager FROM tickets WHERE COALESCE(workflowModel,'legacy')<>'department_tasks' AND status NOT IN ('closed','requester_confirmed')

checks.name: administrativelyClosed
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS orders,COUNT(*) AS nonFinalItems FROM purchase_orders p JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.purchaseOrderId=p.id WHERE p.status IN ('received','closed') AND i.status NOT IN ('delivered_to_warehouse','delivered_to_requester','cancelled','purchase_cancelled','rejected')

checks.name: receivedLocationData
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS receivedItems,SUM(p.siteId IS NULL) AS orderWithoutSite,SUM(COALESCE(p.siteId,t.siteId) IS NULL) AS noOrderOrTicketSite,SUM(CASE WHEN p.siteId IS NULL THEN i.actualTotalCost ELSE 0 END) AS actualValueWithoutOrderSite,SUM(CASE WHEN p.siteId IS NULL AND t.siteId IS NOT NULL THEN i.actualTotalCost ELSE 0 END) AS actualValueWithLinkedTicketSite FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id=i.purchaseOrderId LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.id=p.ticketId WHERE i.status IN ('delivered_to_warehouse','delivered_to_requester')

checks.name: positiveControls
checks.sql: SELECT 'negative_inventory_quantity' AS checkName,COUNT(*) AS exceptions FROM inventory WHERE quantity<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'negative_lot_remaining',COUNT(*) FROM inventory_lots WHERE remainingQuantity<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'negative_lot_balance',COUNT(*) FROM inventory_lot_balances WHERE quantity<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'purchase_item_without_order',COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order_items i LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id=i.purchaseOrderId WHERE p.id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'ticket_item_without_ticket',COUNT(*) FROM ticket_items i LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.id=i.ticketId WHERE t.id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'allocation_amount_mismatch',COUNT(*) FROM inventory_issue_cost_allocations WHERE ABS(allocatedCostTotal-ROUND(quantity*lotIssueUnitCostSnapshot,2))>0.01

checks.name: returnQuantityControl
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returnsExceedingOriginalIssue FROM delivery_documents d JOIN (SELECT sourceDeliveryDocumentId,SUM(returnedQuantity) AS returned FROM warehouse_returns WHERE sourceDeliveryDocumentId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sourceDeliveryDocumentId) r ON r.sourceDeliveryDocumentId=d.id WHERE r.returned>d.quantity+0.0005
